integrity: The 2023 right and dual eigenvector formulas are published antecedents, explicitly cited. The mathematical novelty evaluated here is the sharp projection norm theorem, its Bessel crossover and structural consequences; finite checks are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: The fixed positive coupling asymptotic is pointwise, not uniform as t tends to zero; the Bessel transition is only asserted when m*t_m converges. The t=1 endpoint is excluded. No independent validation, exhaustive priority proof or globally uniform two-parameter expansion is claimed.
title: Exponential Riesz-projection conditioning and Bessel crossover for compact generalized Cesàro operators
